title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 11
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: tiệm tóc, kiểm kê kho, sửa bếp, bưu điện, hiệu sách, nông trại, sửa ô tô, tàu hoả, lớp nấu ăn Thái, hiến máu, giải thưởng thiết kế, cắt điện, đoàn làm phim, trồng cây, nệm, ngày tình nguyện, cuộc thi nghệ thuật, đặt tiệc; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

City Launches Program to Plant 10,000 Trees

FAIRVIEW (April 3) – The City of Fairview has announced a plan to plant 10,000 trees over the next five years. The program, called Green Canopy, aims to provide more shade on city streets and lower summer temperatures in neighborhoods with few trees. – [1] –

Most of the trees will be planted along sidewalks and in public parks. However, residents may also request a free tree for their own front yard. – [2] – City workers will plant the tree, and residents will be responsible for watering it during its first two summers.

The program is funded by a $2 million grant from the state. – [3] – Volunteers are also needed to help with planting events, which will be held on Saturdays in the spring and fall. – [4] –

More information is available at www.fairview.gov/greencanopy.

HARBORVIEW (November 2) – The winners of this year's Harborview Young Artists Competition were announced yesterday. More than 120 teenagers submitted works on the theme "My City."
